title: Secret Rule · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Secret Rule · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: The lead secretly chooses a simple rule, such as words starting with B, and writes it down. The others suggest words; the lead says whether each follows the rule. Someone states the hidden rule correctly within six suggestions. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil; a timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Secret Rule, what counts as a successful turn?
options: Someone states the hidden rule correctly within six suggestions.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: Someone states the hidden rule correctly within six suggestions.
